headline: A federal law renames the U.S. Postal Service building at 220 Fremont Street in Kiel, Wisconsin, after Trooper Trevor J. Casper.
what_it_does: This act officially names the Postal Service facility at 220 Fremont Street in Kiel, Wisconsin, as the Trooper Trevor J. Casper Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building and does not change how mail is handled there.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 25, 2024, and the designation took effect on that date.
